div.style: color: rgb(156, 163, 175) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
qqH() = return false (HARDCODED)
isDaemonCliEnabled gate
blocks 'claude daemon list/install/status/etc'
'claude daemon run' BYPASSES
'claude service install' BLOCKED

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two install paths
A: spawn-fork claude daemon run
--origin auto (detached .unref())
B: systemd-user / launchd
--origin service; com.anthropic.claude-daemon

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CZH() = serverMapBuilder('[feature-flag]',false)
isAgentsFleetEnabled gate (GrowthBook)
gates --bg/--background/logs/attach/kill/respawn/rm
SERVER-FLIPPABLE without binary release
current cohort: NOT PRESENT → defaults false

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Auto-spawn dispatch chain (fleet-enabled):
claude --bg → mz8() spawnBackgroundFork
→ b3H → J_5 → TN6 → C3H
→ spawn claude daemon run --origin auto

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sz8() spare-worker pre-warm
useEffect on Agents Fleet component mount
auto-spawns on every session render
(also gated by CZH — component hidden if false)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
allow_remote_control
managed-policy kill-switch
fail-closed upstream

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fn() resolver
managedPolicy.remoteControlAtStartup
?? userSettings.remoteControlAtStartup
(project-scope NOT consulted)

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
r74() dialog gate
!remoteDialogSeen && NT() && OAuth
(non-interactive skips dialog)
dialog component i74 — title 'Remote Control'
useEffect: remoteDialogSeen=true on MOUNT

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
K_5() env redact (spawn-fork only)
clears INVOCATION_ID always
strips OAuth token + OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
on Linux/Windows if refresh token in keychain
INHERITS both on macOS (#101)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LY4() main loop
spawnMode: same-dir | worktree
staleCheckIntervalMs / idleGraceMs

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Single-instance lock
daemon.json + process.kill(pid,0)
ESRCH=proceed, reachable=exit

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[feature-flag]
JG6() binary-target watch
systemd Restart=always RestartSec=1
WantedBy=default.target (autostart)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Zombie recovery
[feature-flag]
PID-0 probe + 2s wait + respawn

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Socket root
/tmp/cc-daemon-<uid>/<sha256(cfg-dir)[:8]>
_18() uid-ownership check
chmod 0o700 enforced
refuses to bind on foreign-uid dir

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
control.sock — supervisor RPC
15 ops: ping/nudge/lease/dispatch/list/has/kill
reply/subscribe/attach/resize/ensure-spare
permission-response/respawn-stale/await-ack

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
~/.claude/daemon/pipe.key (16-hex)
Windows: embedded in pipe name (auth)
Linux: file created but UNUSED
(fs perms on sock dir = auth)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DCS escape framing
\\x1B_cc-detach-msg;...\\x1B\\\\
PTY-compatible IPC

source: shell|slash|fleet|respawn
isolation: none|worktree
